text_en: “Call now; is there anyone who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?
text_cn: 任你呼求，看有谁答应你？诸圣者中，看你转向哪一位？

text_en: Surely vexation kills the fool, and jealousy slays the simple.
text_cn: 的确，忧愤杀死愚人，怒火使痴者丧生。

text_en: I have seen fools taking root, but suddenly I cursed their dwelling.
text_cn: 我知道：愚人一根深蒂固，他的居所即被诅咒；

text_en: Their children are far from safety, they are crushed in the gate, and there is no one to deliver them.
text_cn: 他的子女，无人支援，在城门前被践踏，无人救护。

text_en: The hungry eat their harvest, and they take it even out of the thorns; and the thirsty pant after their wealth.
text_cn: 他们收获的，饥饿者来吃；且将剩余的，抢去储存；他们的财富，为口渴者喝尽。

text_en: For misery does not come from the earth, nor does trouble sprout from the ground;
text_cn: 因为灾祸不是由土中而来，忧患不是生自地中；

text_en: but human beings are born to trouble just as sparks fly upward.
text_cn: 而是人自寻苦恼，如雏鹰自会飞翔。

text_en: “As for me, I would seek God, and to God I would commit my cause.
text_cn: 如果是我，我必投奔天主，向天主陈诉我的案情。

text_en: He does great things and unsearchable, marvelous things without number.
text_cn: 他所作的大事，高深莫测；他所行的奇事，不可胜数：

text_en: He gives rain on the earth and sends waters on the fields;
text_cn: 他使雨落在地上，引水滋润郊田；

text_en: he sets on high those who are lowly, and those who mourn are lifted to safety.
text_cn: 使卑微的人高升，使受苦的人获得救助；

text_en: He frustrates the devices of the crafty, so that their hands achieve no success.
text_cn: 粉碎狡猾人的计谋，使他们的作为一无所成；

text_en: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; and the schemes of the wily are brought to a quick end.
text_cn: 以智者的计谋捕捉智者，使奸猾人的策划即时成空；

text_en: They meet with darkness in the daytime, and grope at noonday as in the night.
text_cn: 他们白日遇到黑暗，正午摸索如在夜间；

text_en: But he saves the needy from the sword of their mouth, from the hand of the mighty.
text_cn: 他搭救被剥削者脱离人口，挽救穷人摆脱强暴的手。

text_en: So the poor have hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.
text_cn: 如此，贫苦的人获得希望，邪恶将闭口无言。

text_en: “How happy is the one whom God reproves; therefore do not despise the discipline of the Almighty.
text_cn: 的确，天主所惩戒的人是有福的：全能者的训戒，你不可忽视。

text_en: For he wounds, but he binds up; he strikes, but his hands heal.
text_cn: 因为他打伤了，而又包扎伤口；他击碎了，而又亲手治疗。

text_en: He will deliver you from six troubles; in seven no harm shall touch you.
text_cn: 你六次遭难，他次次拯救；到第七次，灾难不会临于你。

text_en: In famine he will redeem you from death, and in war from the power of the sword.
text_cn: 饥馑中，他必救你不死；战争中，必使你得免刀剑。

text_en: You shall be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, and shall not fear destruction when it comes.
text_cn: 唇枪舌剑，你必能躲藏；大难来临，你不必张惶；

text_en: At destruction and famine you shall laugh, and shall not fear the wild animals of the earth.
text_cn: 对大难和饥荒，你可置之一笑；对地上的野兽，也不用惊惶。

text_en: For you shall be in league with the stones of the field, and the wild animals shall be at peace with you.
text_cn: 你将与田野的顽石立约，旷野的猛兽必与你和好。

text_en: You shall know that your tent is safe, you shall inspect your fold and miss nothing.
text_cn: 你将见到你的帐幕平安无恙，察看羊栏时，一无所失。

text_en: You shall know that your descendants will be many, and your offspring like the grass of the earth.
text_cn: 你将确知子孙繁昌，你的苗裔犹如田野青草。

text_en: You shall come to your grave in ripe old age, as a shock of grain comes up to the threshing floor in its season.
text_cn: 你必高年才葬于墓，好像麦捆准时收藏。

text_en: See, we have searched this out; it is true. Hear, and know it for yourself. ”
text_cn: 看，这是我们所观察的真理，你若细听，自会获益良多。
